on Tuesday announced announced the pricing of its offering of $125 million in aggregate principal amount of 6.250% senior notes due 2030 at 99.375% of par.
The offering was upsized from the previously announced offering size of $100 million. It is expected to close on October 1, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
LandBridge intends to use the net proceeds from the offering to repay a portion of outstanding borrowings under its revolving credit facility.

title: LandBridge prices upsized $125M offering of 6.250% senior notes due 2030
